title: Enforce Iteration, Token, and Harmful-Proposal Limits

story.so_that: agentic refinement remains bounded in cost and execution regardless of agent behavior
story.i_want: the workflow to enforce iteration and token limits, account for retry usage, and stop after repeated confirmed harmful proposals

journey.before: Submits or starts an agentic EDD refinement workflow and expects it to run safely within configured bounds
journey.during: Monitors or awaits the outcome, expecting the workflow to self-limit and hand off when limits or repeated regressions are reached
journey.after: Receives the best accepted state produced so far, plus a human-readable handoff report if the workflow could not continue autonomously

capability_breakdown.core_action: Bounds autonomous refinement by checking iteration count, cumulative token usage, consecutive regression history, and unresolved evidence before scheduling each next step
inputs: Observable token usage for every Activity attempt, including retries
Completed revert and recovery check results
Pending flaky/inconclusive evaluation evidence or unverified recovery state
Best accepted state tracked so far
Hard limits for proposed next agentic or evaluation step
outputs: Decision to schedule or stop the next refinement step
Human handoff report when stopped by consecutive regressions
state_changes: Durable logical iteration counter is updated
Workflow enters a halted or handoff terminal state
Best accepted state is preserved for exit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the cumulative token budget or maximum iteration count has been reached, when the workflow checks its limits, then it schedules no further refinement step and exits with the best accepted state.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the cumulative token budget or maximum iteration count has been reached When the workflow checks its limits Then it schedules no further refinement step and exits with the best accepted state
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Keep refinement within configured budget and iteration bounds

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given three consecutive proposed changes have each produced a confirmed regression, when the third revert and recovery check complete, then the workflow stops immediately regardless of remaining iteration or token budget and publishes a human handoff report of the three attempts.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given three consecutive proposed changes have each produced a confirmed regression When the third revert and recovery check completes Then the workflow stops immediately regardless of remaining budget or iterations and publishes a human handoff report of the three attempts
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Receive a human handoff after repeated harmful regression attempts

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given scheduling another agentic or evaluation step would exceed a known hard limit, when the workflow checks before scheduling, then that step is not scheduled.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given scheduling another agentic or evaluation step would exceed a known hard limit When the workflow checks before scheduling Then that step is not scheduled
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Prevent known limit violations before scheduling

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an Activity is retried after a timeout or worker restart, when token usage is tallied, then the retry does not count as an additional logical iteration, but its observable token usage still counts toward the cumulative budget.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an Activity is retried after a timeout or worker restart When token usage is tallied Then the retry does not count as an additional logical iteration but its observable token usage still counts toward the cumulative budget
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Account for retry cost without inflating iteration count

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given unresolved flaky or inconclusive evaluation evidence, or an unverified recovery, is pending, when the workflow checks limits, then it does not schedule another autonomous refinement step until the pending condition is resolved.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given unresolved flaky or inconclusive evaluation evidence or an unverified recovery is pending When the workflow checks limits Then it does not schedule another autonomous refinement step until the pending condition is resolved
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Pause autonomous refinement until pending evidence is resolved
